QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] A Show of Support
QuestInfo.0: You meet the street performer #bRuthie Bea#k in the #rKerning Tower Lobby#k. Her skills are a bit on the unrefined side, but she has a heck of a lot of energy. Everyone watching her performance is cheering her on.
QuestInfo.1: You know your music is good when the crowd goes nuts! Gather #b15#k #b#i4036018:# #t4036018:##k items and bring them to Ruthie Bea. You can get them from #rall monsters in Kerning Tower#k.
QuestInfo.2: Nothing fires up a musician more than a roaring crowd! She may need more practice, but her confidence was through the roof. Ruthie stayed cool and shined like the evening sun.

0.msg: #b(Onlookers shower the street performer with tribute. Their cheering is so contagious that you can't help but join in.)#k

1.msg: #b(Her skills are a bit on the unrefined side, but she has a heck of a lot of energy. She has the potential to be a star! Will you give a little #e#t4036018:##n to Ruthie Bea, the street performer?)#k

yes.1: The adrenaline surge you get from a hoard of screaming fans... I've never felt anything like it! They've inspired me to sing even harder and louder than ever before!
